status_note: All three cases match the locked Ghidra 12.0.4 oracle byte-for-byte, including the real xrefControlFlow CALLOTHER arm through the `cpuid` userop (index 44) on both sides, label-relative payload branches, moveSequenceDead placement and the multi-op bookkeeping. The CALLFIXUP trigger (queryCall->copyFlowEffects) and the inlineSubFunction clone remain registered residuals.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: doInjection(payload,icontext,op,fc): payload/icontext read-only, op shared across xref/moveSequence/updateTarget/opDestroyRaw; fc threads into setupCallSpecs/setupCallindSpecs for the injection recursion check; the emitter (PcodeEmitFd::dump / inject_raw_ops_single) appends ops to the shared bank - observed via the post-generateBlocks op list, block assignment and drained injectlist.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: injectPcode walks injectlist slots in order, nullifying each as consumed (flow.cc:1330-1333); generateOps expands injections after the initial fallthru sweep (794-795) and again after the tablelist refill inside the do-while body (815-820); SleighBuilder walks the template opvec in order; resolveRelatives walks label_refs in record order against labels[id]-calling_index.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: obank uniqid is one counter across machine and injected ops (SeqNum time column); PcodeCacher labels grows with the 0xbadbeef sentinel; InjectContext clear() resets inputlist/output only; injectlist drains to empty exactly once per pending op.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: setupParameters binds parameter index -> fixed handle (inputs 0..n-1 then outputs n.., orderParameters); ConstTpl::Handle compares (handle_index, select) with v_offset_plus using plus&0xffff (non-const) or >>8*(plus>>16) (const); op observation iterates the PcodeOpTree SeqNum (address, then time) order; blocks observe generation order.

rugra_source.archive_policy: Immutable explicit dependency closure plus two verified src overlays (flow.rs + pcodeinject.rs); unrelated worktree files are excluded

apis: FlowInfo::injectSubFunction (flow.cc:1284-1303, signature only - trigger blocked by CALLSPEC-0001)
analysis_options.funcdata: Three BfdArchitecture shells, one per case, over the fixture-binary .text; inject_cpuid registers the callother-fixup through the public UserOpManage::manualCallOtherFixup (the engine already registered the unspecialized 'cpuid' descriptor from the .sla userop table) and drives the ordinary Funcdata::followFlow, so xrefControlFlow's CALLOTHER arm queues the injection on its own; the two seeded cases compile the payload through the real SLEIGH snippet compiler, install an InjectedUserOp at a synthetic index beyond the engine's userop table (explicit-instantiation access to the private UserOpManage::registerOp on the Ghidra side; direct descriptor registration on the Rugra side), construct a synthetic CALLOTHER at the probe entry and hand-drive FlowInfo (private injectlist seeded on the Ghidra side, documented fixture_queue_inject observation hook on the Rugra side) before the real generateOps/generateBlocks
analysis_options.probe_construction: naked noinline C functions; every probe body is pure asm (xor/ret streams of varying length) so the emitted bytes are exactly the designed instruction stream; endbr64 (4 bytes, -fcf-protection) precedes each body, shifting deltas by +4 on both sides identically

generateops_hasinject_wiring.covers: flow.cc:794-795 post-fallthru gate fires injectPcode for the seeded injection in every case; the flow.cc:819-820 do-while site executes with an empty list (no phase-2 queue source exists under the pinned specs).

inject_pcode_dispatch_callother.covers: flow.cc:1327-1355 slot nullification + CALLOTHER arm -> injectUserOp; the destroyed CALLOTHER and drained inject_pending=0 are observed in all three cases.

inject_user_op_context_and_payload.covers: flow.cc:1212-1236 userop index lookup, payload resolution by inject id, InjectContext fill (baseaddr=op addr, inputlist from in[1..], output) - observed via the substituted operand/output storage in the injected ops.

do_injection_emit_and_bookkeeping.covers: flow.cc:1177-1208 template emit through the PcodeEmit bridge (every injected op carries the base address), full xrefControlFlow over injected ops (block starts, label-relative branch, dead-tail rules), guarded markIncidentalCopy, moveSequenceDead placement (block-0 op order), updateTarget and opDestroyRaw.

payload_template_execution.covers: inject_sleigh.cc:48-65 + semantics.cc:116-215 + sleigh.cc:120-144/221-280: operand-handle substitution, const-space masking, label-relative resolution (labels[id]-calling_index), the base-address emission and op order for the copy/add/label snippets match byte-for-byte.

xref_control_flow_callother_arm.covers: flow.cc:344-348: the x86-64 SLEIGH engine emits CALLOTHER(44) for the real `cpuid` instruction, so case inject_cpuid queues the fixup through xrefControlFlow's CALLOTHER arm on BOTH sides with no seeding; the destroyed CALLOTHER(44) (and surviving CALLOTHERs 45-48+) are observed in the op list.

callfixup_trigger_via_querycall.covers: flow.cc:1337-1345 injectSubFunction arm: triggering it through real flow requires queryCall -> copyFlowEffects to set isInline+injectId on a call spec; Rugra's query_call is a documented no-op (CALLSPEC-0001). The injectSubFunction body itself (context with calladdr, doInjection with fc, paramshift to qlst.back()) is ported and compiles, exercised by the shared doInjection path.

inline_subfunction_clone.covers: flow.cc:1347-1350 / 1242-1277 inlineSubFunction: the recursion bookkeeping is ported; the actual Funcdata::inlineFlow partial clone is a documented TODO so the arm cannot complete through real flow yet.

out_of_scope_observations.note: Rugra's AddressSpace tag enum carries no highest/addrsize metadata: non-const/unique wrapOffset reduction and j_curspace_size resolution are documented glue (ADDRESS-0001 family); no fixture snippet reaches them.
injectPcode warningHeaders lack the call-spec name (Rugra FuncCallSpecs are unnamed until ActionFuncLink); no CALL-arm case runs under the pinned specs so no warning line is produced on either side.
